headline: Forest villa is a villa for sale in Uzumlu Türkiye and boasts a separate self contained 1 bedroom apartment.
description: Forest villa is a villa for sale in Uzumlu Türkiye and boasts a separate self contained 1 bedroom apartment.

Forest villa is a 7 bedroom fully furnished property boasting stunning forest and valley views. This villa for sale in Uzumlu is a must view property if you like to be away from the noise yet only 5 minutes drive to the village center.
This property is on 4 floors and boasts a 700ms plot of land that is gated with it's own private swimming pool and garden areas.

What we can say is the Forest Villa has great potential as only 3 floors are currently in use with the top floor which has 4 bedrooms with a roof terrace not used screaming out for someone's creativity.
The main living area of the Forest villa is a large lounge with an alcove that leads you to what is a huge dining area, kitchen and stunning terrace that over looks the valley.

The lounge as you can see by the photos is a good size with a nice wood burning stove for the winter periods. The property has Air conditioning for the summer period. Adjacent to the lounge we have in this beautiful villa for sale in Uzumlu a very large area for family and friends socializing.

This property is ideal for large families or the perfect property to rent out to groups. The dining area is just wonderful with great space and light which over looks the fully fitted kitchen area which comes with all built in appliances. An impressive island also takes center stage in what is probably the main hub of this large villa, the kitchen and dining area.
Double doors lead us from here to a huge terrace which over looks the garden area. Another great area to entertain your family and guests!

The marble staircase from the hallway leads us to the next floor which has 2 very large bedrooms (both en suite) both also with balconies. One has views of the valley and the other over looks the swimming pool and garden areas. These rooms are again larger than most and both come with large wardrobes and bedroom furniture.
Top floor

There are currently 4 bedroom on the top floor that are not currently used and a blank canvas if you feel 7 bedrooms is too much. The views from one of the bedrooms is fantastic with views over the Uzumlu valley. There is a bathroom on this level also. For more photos of this part please contact us.
The lower garden floor with a one bedroom self contained apartment.
You can enter this apartment from the lounge above or go via the garden area for entry. It has an open lounge with double doors leading you to a large seating area on the lower garden area.

Adjacent to the lounge we have a 1 double bedroom coming fully furnished. We also have a new modern kitchen area again coming with built in appliances. Storage and a toilet have also been added to make this apartment area more comfortable. This has been a very good modern project adding real value to what is a beautiful spacious villa.

The garden area can be accessed from stairs leading from the street. There is a large BBQ area ideal for table and chairs, a lower level again perfect for chilling and the poolside. Each part of the garden offers you something different and it is mostly slabbed for lower maintenance but it has still kept its charm with the many fruit trees available.
The location

Yeşil Üzümü is regarded as one , if not the the most beautiful village in the Fethiye area. The village is just stunning. Even though it has still kept its tradition and charm it also offers some nice restaurant/ bars were you can meet locals and tourists. Many a movie has been made in this village just to give you an understanding of how beautiful it is. There are weekly markets and yearly festivals held here. The Forest Villa is just a 5 minute drive or a bus from the main road into the village.

The main town is of course Fethiye about 25 minutes drive. Here it is just wonderful with everything to offer that any main town or city can. Buses also travel daily from Yeşil Üzümlü to Fethiye town center.

Overall, this is a beautiful villa set at a great price to sell, ideal for a family, to rent out or as a long term investment. It is coming fully furnished, so a turn key property waiting for the right person. For more information please contact us direct on 0090 5340520030 English or 0090 5349223032 Turkish

description: Amazing price reduction!

The Oasis Platinum Apart is a property for sale in Turkey situated on a stunning complex which boasts many swimming pools and a Tennis courtThe apartment is on the first floor and is a duplex property.
This gives this apartment a wonderful advantage over others as it offers stunning mountain and field views. Situated in a private location only 10 minutes drive from the resort of Çaliş beach.
The complex

As stated it is in a green area yet very close to the 2 major resorts of Çaliş and Fethiye and is only 45 minutes from the nearest airport. The local bus runs frequently from here taking you to both resorts. The complex boasts , villas, Bungalows, apartments and Town houses. The site is gated with 24 hour manned security at the gates. Can you believe their are 5 swimming pools! Depending on what location your property is will dictate what pool you would use, but you have the choice of using them all. Right next to the Oasis Platinum Apart are 2 large pools and a children's pool.

The complex is beautiful. A one way road system is deployed inside the grounds with lot's of parking space. On site there is also a park Gym, Cafe and let's not forget a Tennis court for the active. The grounds are stunning and the upkeep is ongoing and at a good standard. You can easily holiday on this complex without leaving. There is a pathway to the sea which has a secluded beach (approx 20 minutes) plus a short drive away (10 minutes) you will find the lovely Karaot beach which has a great restaurant and definitely a place to spend time at if you are the lucky owner of this property.
The property

This property for sale in Turkey is a three bedroom on two floors. There is an apartment below this one. The courtyard that leads you up to this property is very nice and spacious with access to 2 swimming pools which this apartment over looks. The entrance level has Lounge, kitchen, 2 double bedrooms, shower room and a balcony.

What we can say is the property interior is showroom style throughout. Although coming unfurnished the fixtures and fittings are all quality. So, we enter into the hallway and first come to the stunning modern fitted kitchen. Again the standard is very high with sleek modern doors, marble worktops , built in oven, hob and extractor and finished off with a stunning easy wipe glass backsplash. One of the best fitted kitchens we have seen in an apartment in a long time. Adjacent we have great storage space that leads you to the the lounge. The lounge is facing the back of the complex so very private and quiet. The double doors lead you onto a large balcony which has a built in BBQ and over looks the gardens, pool and offers quite stunning mountain views. From the kitchen to the lounge then to the balcony flows real good!

We have a double room off the lounge area. At the other end of the hallway we have another double bedroom which boasts large built in wardrobes plus a shared shower room. This has ceramics, floor to ceiling and has a glass front with a modern shower. Next we have a vanity unit with mirror and extra storage. Again the quality throughout is impressive!
The upper floor

The Marble stairs take us to the next level. Here we have a huge bedroom that is en suite with 2 large roof terraces. This is a fantastic space! The roadside has a terrace (sun afternoon till evening) and the back garden area has a roof terrace (sun morning till afternoon). 2 great additions to this property. The views over the garden roof terrace are quite stunning and a must to see.

Overall, If you are looking for a property that is in a quiet area yet just 10 minutes from a town then this is perfect. As stated earlier you do not really need to leave the complex. The site is stunning and duty to care is evident as you walk through the stunning gardens and pool areas. That is just the complex but the apartment compliments the site. We highly recommend viewing for this property for sale in Turkey.

title: Stone House Uzumlu
headline: The stone House in YeşilÜzümlü is a stunning property that we are excited to have on our portfolio.
description: The stone House in YeşilÜzümlü is a stunning property that we are excited to have on our portfolio.

Every now and then a property that we see is great value for the purchaser comes on the market and this is truly one of them. A villa like this at this price also makes this a fantastic future investment. It is a private property set on a plot of land of 625ms. Property for sale in YeşilÜzümlü can sometimes be way up the mountain or out of the village but this is the perfect location.
Very private with just a few beautiful villas in the area yet walking distance to the village itself.
This is a walled property for privacy and wait till you see what is behind those walls. Photos do not do this justice!
Let's start with the exterior

Stone walls that are fitting to the surroundings. The gardens have many different parts to explore. We have of course the poolside which has a kidney shaped pool and a great size for family fun. Around the pool area we have also a Turkish Kuş (covered seating area) which is a brilliant area to get out of the sun in the hot summer months to cools down. This can also be used in the winter months as it can close up also. Not only is it practical, but it looks fantastic.

Another part just behind the Kuş is a grassed area that boast many kind of fruit trees and again looks just beautiful. The whole pool area and adjacent is quite wonderful but what awaits us at the back of the villa is quite magnificent.

We have a few good size garden sheds but behind them we have the entertainment garden i would call it. If you have guests i am sure they would love to spend a lot of time here. There is a large working fountain taking center stage. Adjacent to this there is a lovely built in seating area with cushions and table . The other end we have again a very unusual open kitchen area purpose built to entertain. Built in BBQ, marble worktops, storage, fridge etc. Again not only looking great but practical. The gardens go on but what we can say you will fall in love with every part of the outside area as there has been so much attention to detail given everywhere.
The property

The villa is partially stone built with only 1 owner. The entrance has that real country house feel. The first thing that will catch your eye is the wonderful wooden staircase taking you to the upper floor. We pass this and enter into the lounge, kitchen and dining room areas. The lounge walls are stone keeping in fitting with the property. The floors look wooden throughout but are actually wood effect ceramic. The whole ground floor has had a full modern renovation. We have adjacent to the lounge a large dining area with table and chairs plus a large dressing table. Again the interior walls are real stone. The dining area and kitchen are really beautiful.

The kitchen is new modern and again complimenting the villa. Focal point being the island with a black marble surface giving lot's more worktop space but also lot's more storage space. The doors are sleek, modern and just so much imagination has gone into the storage space that is here. The kitchen size is large regardless but just a fantastic use of space by the architect!

The main worktops are black marble throughout. All appliances will be left in the sale of the property. Oven, hob, extractor, dish washer, tall fridge freezer to name a few and all top quality. The wonderful thing about the ground level is we have a door from the kitchen to the stunning fountain and seating entertainment area plus another door from the dining area on to a large wrap around terrace that over looks the pool. This can be open in the summer and closed in the winter months. A real large extra seating area. The ground floor has also a toilet that is quite beautiful with designer sink and utility unit.
Upper floor

The stunning wooden staircase takes you to the next level. All the floors a real wood on this level. We have 3 double bedrooms, 1 en suite and a shared shower room. Bedroom one we would class as the master bedroom is very large with en suite. The en suite is a shower room with cubicle and vanity unit. Wooden floors and lot's of big furniture in terms of wardrobes and units. The doors lead you to a small French window with beautiful country views. There is also access to a large balcony that again has the most stunning mountain views plus pool and gardens. You could spend most of your day chilling here easily.
Bedroom two again is very large. Wooden floors and big floor to ceiling built in wardrobes and again access to the same balcony as bedroom one with the same stunning views.
Bedroom Three again is the smallest but still a double. Another balcony with a different mountain view to the back. Stunning.
Remember throughout the property there are central heating radiators that are hidden with a nice wood effect again to blend into the villa style. Each bedroom have these!
The location

Yeşilüzümlü village has got to be the most beautiful in the area. It is real traditional. You can see animals everywhere , villagers going through their normal days work and at the same time they have incorporated facilities like restaurants, cafes, shops etc for the x pat community which is quite high. Üzümlü has kept it's charm. It is only half an hour by bus from the main square to the town of Fethiye which is stunning with it's Marina, promenade and parks. There is an open weekly market also which is a great day for locals to all meet up. Tour buses sometimes visit the village so that tells you how important it is in the area. History surrounds the village. On the top we have Cadianda the ancient city which is quite wonderful over looking the village. The beauty is to be seen around the village of Yeşilüzümlü!
Contact us for more details or for viewings. We highly recommend viewing as this property is great value and as stated before a great future investment!

description: Courtside villa is a town house property set on what must be said one of the most beautiful complex's in the area. A beautiful Turkish property for sale. Great price reduction!

This villa is set on grounds that boast some beautiful gardens that are maintained all year round, many swimming pools and a working poolside bar and restaurant. There is even a tennis court for the active! Turkish property for sale in this area are sought after!

This property is set by what is regarded the main swimming pool and bar area. At this moment they are working on a covered social area next to the restaurant which will add value to the site. The Oasis complex is only 10 minutes drive from the resort of Çaliş beach and 5 minutes drive to the lovely karaot beach with it's restaurant that serves cheap meals and drinks.
The Courtside Villa is a Turkish property for sale that is a must for viewing if you like the quieter side of resorts yet very close to enjoy the chaos if you want it.
The property

A three floor town house coming furnished! The ground level is the lounge and dining area, open kitchen and shared toilet. The lounge is a good size with double doors leading you onto a large terrace area over looking the pool and gardens. This is the place to entertain if you do not wish to be at the bar area. The building is very attractive with columns giving it a grand look. The terrace area also has a built in stone BBQ for those summer months. Access to the pool and gardens can be had from this point also.

Adjacent to the lounge and dining area we have a small kitchen that comes with some built in appliances like oven, hob and extractor fan plus, dishwasher and tall fridge freezer. There is storage space also so although small , everything you would possibly need is here. This level we also have a ground floor shared toilet space.
The middle floor

Marble stairs lead you to the first floor where we have 2 double bedrooms both en suite. One is current with twin beds, built in wardrobes and of course en suite. A really nice balcony also from this bedroom has great views over the tennis court. This is a very quiet and peaceful complex so there is never too much noise , even from the tennis court , but it is a lovely view from this bedroom.

Bedroom 2 is to the inside of the complex facing the swimming pool and gardens. A double bedroom with furnishings, fitted wardrobe, bedside cabinets etc and again en suite. The double doors lead you onto a wonderful balcony area that overlooks the pool, gardens and restaurant. Stunning views from this point .
Top floor

The marble staircase is wide and easy to walk up and down. It has a good flow. The top floor room is a large double bedroom and the same as the others comes with fitted wardrobes and bedside cabinets. Again another en suite bathroom. That is 3 en suites! The double doors from this bedroom lead you to a brilliant roof terrace. Not only is it big but it has the most stunning views of not only the complex area but the country side of Yaniklar. It is all green and beautiful, so this is obviously facing west and a sun trap for all you sun worshipers . A great place to put your sunbeds and get some sun privacy.
The property comes with air conditioning throughout plus many extras so please call us for more in depth information on the property and the complex!
The area

Courtside villa complex is in what looks rural but just 10 minutes from Çaliş beach resort. Dalaman airport is only 45 minutes away. There are beaches and forest havens all around this location. Stunningly a beautiful place to own a property. The town of Fethiye is about a 15 minute drive and is quite beautiful also with it's Marina, old town, promenade, parks, shopping, cafes, restaurants and historical sights. Many top 5 star hotels are now choosing this location to do business. Hikers love it and there are things like horse riding stables close by, rivers, forests and ofcourse the Oasis complex itself which is stunning all year. Watch my video on the river close by in Green Valley.
A turn key property for sure. Viewing is highly recommended!

Just 10 minutes away lies the world-famous Ölüdeniz Beach and Blue Lagoon, internationally renowned for its crystal-clear turquoise waters, soft golden sands and protected natural beauty. Frequently ranked among the world's finest beaches, Ölüdeniz also offers an array of beachfront restaurants, stylish cafés, water sports and the iconic Babadağ Mountain , home to one of the world's premier paragliding destinations.

The lively resort of Hisarönü is only a 5-minute drive from the property, offering an excellent selection of international restaurants, traditional Turkish cuisine, boutique shops, cafés, bars and a vibrant nightlife, making it a favourite destination for both residents and visitors.

The cosmopolitan harbour town of Fethiye is approximately 25 minutes away, offering a sophisticated blend of traditional charm and contemporary living. From its picturesque marina and palm-lined waterfront promenade to the atmospheric Old Town (Paspatur), luxury shopping, fine dining, bustling fish market and modern amenities, Fethiye is regarded as one of the most desirable coastal towns in the Mediterranean.
Combining tranquil forest surroundings with exceptional access to beaches, marinas, restaurants and year-round amenities, this remarkable location offers the very best of Mediterranean living.
